review.notes: Self-review confirmed the MIC registry CSV, cited test reports, and user-held private physical-label photograph identify Archer AX23V / JP/1.0 with certification number 201-230283. The test-report originals are now private local evidence; their official source URLs and SHA-256 values remain in the evidence bundle and local retention policy. The private photo is hash-recorded in the evidence bundle and excluded from this repository because it contains a serial number. The W56 channel observation was also re-reviewed against report 201-230283_02_003.pdf: its value now enumerates the distinct 20 MHz, 40 MHz, and 80 MHz channel sets rather than implying an inclusive 100-144 range.
